principle.name: CADENCE CHANGES SPACING WITHOUT RESETTING SUPPORT PHASE
principle.summary: Coil on current support; widen root gaps through alternating surge; collapse gaps through probe/acquire/brake; exit with displaced recovery debt.

keys.attitude: head leads a little; rear arm trails

keys.name: RIGHT_FOOT_SEARCH

keys.name: RIGHT_FOOT_ACQUIRE

keys.causal_role: first fast catch preserves phase and turns flight into support

keys.name: LEFT_CATCH_ABSORB
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (37,19): +2 x, +3 y; forward travel is paid into compression

keys.name: LEFT_DRIVE_WHIP

keys.name: RIGHT_OVERSTRIDE_REACH

keys.name: RIGHT_CATCH_SURGE

keys.name: LEFT_CATCH_RUNOUT

keys.name: LEFT_BRAKE_COIL

keys.name: LEFT_BRAKE_REBOUND
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (80,17): +3 x, -3 y; compression rebounds but travel is shorter

keys.name: SHORT_FLIGHT_BRAKE

keys.name: RIGHT_HEEL_PROBE

keys.name: RIGHT_HEEL_ACQUIRE

keys.causal_role: transfer L→R through explicit probe/acquire

keys.name: RIGHT_BRAKE_DEEP

keys.name: TORSO_FORWARD_OVERSHOOT

keys.name: LEFT_RECOVERY_PROBE

keys.name: LEFT_RECOVERY_ACQUIRE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (83,18): -1 x, -1 y; left support catches rebound
keys.causal_role: release right brake foot only after left contact earns trust

keys.name: LEFT_REBOUND_SETTLE

keys.name: RIGHT_STEP_SEARCH

keys.causal_role: search right step while left still owns support

keys.name: RIGHT_RECOVERY_STEP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (87,17): +2 x; displaced step catches residual travel
keys.causal_role: transfer L→R and prove cadence can continue

keys.name: EXIT_WITH_LEFT_DEBT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (88,17): +1 x; endpoint stays locomotor while left foot and head point into next stride
keys.causal_role: leave unresolved left-step debt rather than returning to neutral
